claim.claim-text: 1. A sole structure (200) for an article of footwear (10), the sole structure (200) comprising

a fluid-filled chamber (204) having a central portion (224) and a plurality of lobes (226) extending outward from the central portion (224), the plurality of lobes (226) forming a first portion of a peripheral side wall of the sole structure (200) and a midsole (202) having a plurality of projections (208, 210, 212, 214, 216) inter-fitted with the plurality of lobes (226) and forming a second portion of the peripheral side wall of the sole structure (200), the plurality of lobes (226) including a rear medial lobe (228), a rear lateral lobe (230), a front medial lobe (232) and a front lateral lobe (234), wherein a portion of the rear lateral lobe (230) defines a rear longitudinal axis (276) along the peripheral side surface and a portion of the front lateral lobe (234) defines a front longitudinal axis (278) along the peripheral side surface, the rear longitudinal axis (276) being substantially parallel to the front longitudinal axis (278), or wherein a portion of the rear medial lobe (228) defines a rear longitudinal axis (276) along the peripheral side surface and a portion of the front medial lobe (232) defines a front longitudinal axis (278) along the peripheral side surface, the rear longitudinal axis (276) being substantially parallel to the front longitudinal axis (278).

2. The sole structure (200) of Claim 1, wherein a distal end wall (236) of the rear lateral lobe (230) or the rear medial lobe (228) defines a substantially rhomboidal shape, and a distal end wall (236) of the front lateral lobe (234) or the front medial lobe (232) defines a substantially triangular shape.
3. The sole structure (200) of Claim 1, wherein the fluid-filled chamber (204) includes a plurality of tunnels (280) extending between the central portion (224) and the plurality of lobes (226).
4. The sole structure (200) of Claim 3, wherein the plurality of tunnels (280) fluidly couples the plurality of lobes (226) to the central portion (224).

5. The sole structure (200) of Claim 1, wherein the rear medial lobe (228) includes a first portion extending along the medial side of the sole structure (200) and a second portion extending along a posterior end of the sole structure (200).

6. The sole structure (200) of Claim 1, wherein the rear lateral lobe (230) includes a first portion extending along the lateral side of the sole structure (200) and a second portion extending along a posterior end of the sole structure (200).

7. The sole structure (200) of Claim 1, wherein the rear medial lobe (228) includes a first portion extending along the medial side of the sole structure (200) and an arcuate portion extending from the first portion.

8. The sole structure (200) of Claim 1, wherein the rear lateral lobe (230) includes a first portion extending along the lateral side of the sole structure (200) and an arcuate portion extending from the first portion.
9. The sole structure of Claim 1, wherein the rear medial lobe (228) forms an arcuate surface of the peripheral side wall of the sole structure (200).
10. The sole structure of Claim 1, wherein the rear lateral lobe (230) forms an arcuate surface of the peripheral side wall of the sole structure (200).
11. The sole structure (200) of Claim 1, wherein the fluid-filled chamber (204) is asymmetric about a central, longitudinal axis of the fluid-filled chamber (204).
12. An article of footwear (10) incorporating the sole structure (200) of Claim 1.
